text:
LINK::vlan_id
Description
Returns the VLAN tag of the packet. This command is equivalent to the
BIG-IP 4.X variable
vlan_id
.
Syntax
LINK
::
vlan_id
LINK::vlan_id
Returns the VLAN tag of the packet.
Examples
# log requests
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
set
info
"client { [IP::client_addr]:[TCP::client_port] -> [IP::local_addr]:[TCP::local_port] }"
append
info
" ethernet "
append
info
" { [string range [LINK::lasthop] 0 16] -> [string range [LINK::nexthop] 0 16] "
append
info
"tag [LINK::vlan_id] qos [LINK::qos] }"
log
local0.
$info
}
rule
rule_log_requests
{
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
set
info
"client { [IP::client_addr]:[TCP::client_port] -> [IP::local_addr]:[TCP::local_port] }"
append
info
" ethernet "
append
info
" { [string range [LINK::lasthop] 0 16] -> [string range [LINK::nexthop] 0 16] "
append
info
"tag [LINK::vlan_id] qos [LINK::qos] }"
log
local0.
$info
}
